items.title: Nick Mondello interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 19, 2022
items.q: So I engaged Gio, I engaged Jai Florada.

ctx.x: Yeah. It’s out there and you can’t stop it.

He teaches down in Dallas. His name is Giovanni or Gio Washington-Wright. And he’s done tons and tons of transcriptions. I mean he’s a genius when it comes to that and playing.
